# Globals that CheckThat's own files read as nil in the fake client (tests/test_divergence.lua).
# Each name is accepted because the Adapter guards the read and the fake client does not model the name.
# One name per line. A new name or a missing name fails the test.

# Era and Forever differ here: C_AddOns is newer, GetAddOnMetadata older. Adapter.AddonMetadata tries C_AddOns first.
C_AddOns
GetAddOnMetadata

# Not modelled by the fake client; Adapter.Env and App guard them and fall back to UnitName and GetRealmName.
UnitFullName
time

# Settings window close: SettingsPanel is the newer client, InterfaceOptionsFrame the older. The fake has neither.
InterfaceOptionsFrame
SettingsPanel

# Context menu: MenuUtil is the newer menu API, UIDropDownMenu the older. The fake has neither, so the caller falls back.
MenuUtil
UIDropDownMenu_Initialize

# Confirmation dialog: the fake has StaticPopup_Show but not Hide, and no YES and NO labels. Adapter.Confirm falls back to English.
StaticPopup_Hide
YES
NO
